incorrect-term.message: Use "mobile phone" consistently throughout this guide instead of "cell phone".
Use "mobile phone" consistently throughout this guide instead of "cellphone".
Prefer the "phone-name" keyword reference instead of hardcoding the product name, so it can be updated in one place (see the keydef in mobile-phone.ditamap).
Avoid shortening the product name; use the full name "Galaxy X1" (or the "phone-name" keyword reference).
Use "charger" for the supplied charging accessory instead of "adapter".
Use "charger" for the supplied charging accessory instead of "adaptor".
Use "photo"/"photos" for images captured with the camera instead of "picture"/"pictures".
Use "night mode" for the camera's low-light shooting feature; "dark mode" is reserved for the UI theme.
Use "night mode" consistently instead of "low-light mode".
Hyphenate "high-resolution" when used as a compound adjective (e.g. "high-resolution camera").
Spell out "high-resolution" instead of using the informal abbreviation "hi-res".
Hyphenate "long-lasting" when used as a compound adjective (e.g. "long-lasting battery").
Use "5G connectivity" for consistency with the Features topic instead of "5G network".
Use "5G" instead of spelling out "fifth generation".
